create_SLAM_instance: create a SLAM object with a robot proxy, map size, resolution, and obstacle threshold parameters
update_map: run the update_map method to refresh the traversable and semantic maps using current robot sensor data
get_semantic_map_features: build a function that returns local and global semantic map features as a torch tensor with obstacle and category channels
add_obstacles: create a call to add_obstacles with a list of locations in real or map coordinates to mark them on the map
get_traversable_map: run get_traversable_map to retrieve the binary traversable grid showing free space around the robot
